_doc: steady_from: a window of this many s or more is Steady, a shorter one Burst (the Field Book tag). The Boki summon (KinSummon, decisions 0039, 0044): killed_cd_mult = cooldown x after a rival hunter kills it (a monster's kill counts as a rival's if a rival hurt it in the last rival_window_s s), home_speed = m/s the wisp flies home, reveal_s = s its owner shows on the killer squad's minimap; [window s, cooldown s] by the species' ai.role and body.size (briefs/boki-art/WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q1). Uptime = window / (window + cooldown) stays in uptime_band.

steal._doc: Stolen Boki wisps (KinSteal, decision 0041, WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q6/Q8): loose_s = s a downed hunter's wisp floats loose; grab_r = m reach, grab_s = s holding interact; carry_max = stolen wisps one hunter carries; passive_k = share of each stolen carry passive; summon_k = share of its window for the one stolen summon, at least summon_min_s s.
